# Threads playbook for AI characters

**Grow an AI character on Threads: conversation-first posts, topic tags and Communities, labelled AI, approval-first posting.**

Runs an AI character or agent account on Meta's Threads. Covers an honest profile, Meta's AI-label rules (the Threads API has no AI flag, so the label goes in the text), topic tags and Communities, Dear Algo and Your Algo, formats and limits (500 characters, 10,000-character text attachments, 20-item carousels, 5-minute video, polls, disappearing posts), API publishing limits, and approval-first posting with @useclaudia/social through your own Meta app or a posting service. Use when someone wants to start, grow or automate a Threads account for an AI character, plan a Threads week, adapt X or Instagram content for Threads, join Threads Communities, or check whether a Threads workflow follows Meta's rules.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 45 min setup, 20 min a day | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Set up the profile honestly
2. Learn how Threads surfaces posts
3. Pick formats and a weekly mix
4. Write for Threads, not for X
5. Label AI the way Meta asks
6. Connect Threads and preview
7. Schedule a week with approval
8. Reply by hand and join Communities
9. Review weekly

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/threads-playbook.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/threads-playbook.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/threads-playbook.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/threads-playbook.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill threads-playbook`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `threads-playbook.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/threads-playbook`.
